tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List published holiday calendars available to your plan. Optional calendar_type filters by family (CURRENCY_FX, CURRENCY_NON_CLEARING, FINANCIAL_CENTRE, PAYMENT_SYSTEM, EXCHANGE_TRADING, EXCHANGE_SETTLEMENT).

tools.name: get_holidays
tools.description: Holidays for one calendar by code (e.g. USD.FX). start defaults to today; pass an earlier start for historical holidays, end to bound forward dates. Rows carry original_date when a holiday is observed on a shifted date, plus half-day and early-close details.

tools.name: fx_market_holidays
tools.description: FX market holidays for a currency (ISO 4217, e.g. USD): days the FX market for that currency does not trade. start defaults to today.

tools.name: currency_non_clearing_days
tools.description: Currency non-clearing days (ISO 4217, e.g. USD): days the currency cannot clear or settle. Use to validate FX value dates. start defaults to today.

tools.name: bank_holidays
tools.description: Bank holidays for a financial centre (UN/LOCODE, e.g. USNYC): days retail and commercial banks are closed. start defaults to today.

tools.name: payment_system_holidays
tools.description: Payment system holidays (e.g. TARGET2, FEDWIRE): days the system does not process or settle. start defaults to today.

tools.name: trading_holidays
tools.description: Exchange trading holidays for a market (ISO 10383 MIC, e.g. XNYS): days the exchange is closed for trading, including shortened sessions (half_day and early_close_time fields). start defaults to today.

tools.name: settlement_holidays
tools.description: Exchange settlement holidays for a market (ISO 10383 MIC, e.g. XNYS): days clearing and settlement cannot take place. start defaults to today.

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: List covered currencies (ISO 4217) with issuing country and issuer.

tools.name: list_exchanges
tools.description: List covered exchanges (ISO 10383 MIC) with country, city, and timezone.

tools.name: list_financial_centres
tools.description: List covered financial centres (UN/LOCODE) with country and timezone.

tools.name: list_payment_systems
tools.description: List covered payment systems with operator, type, currency, and country.

tools.name: get_weekends
tools.description: Weekend definitions and working weekends for one calendar code (e.g. USD.FX). weekend_days is the definition in force today (ISO weekday numbers); weekend_definitions carries the full history.

tools.name: market_status
tools.description: Live open/half/closed status for exchanges, evaluated against real trading hours and today's trading holidays in each exchange's timezone. tools.description: Is a date a business day? tools.name: add_business_days
tools.description: Date that is N business days after (or before, with negative days) a start date: settlement and value dates (T+1 = 1, T+2 = 2), payment due dates, deadlines. days = 0 rolls a non-business start forward to the next business day. tools.name: business_days_between
tools.description: Number of business days between two dates (start counted, end not counted, like numpy.busday_count), with the non-business days in between and why. calendars: one or more calendar codes from list_calendars, e.g. ["USD.FX", "EUR.FX"] for a EUR/USD FX trade, ["XNYS.SETTLE"] for NYSE settlement, ["TARG
